purpose: Establish the exact moving-control-volume conservation authority for the one-state terminal-band enrichment supported by BC2-B7 before any prognostic interface-flux closure or reduced dynamics is introduced.
width_status: Both widths are carried because BC2-B7 supports both but does not authorize a preferred width.

state_definitions.theta_H: theta_s at the zero-pressure water table

continuous_balance_no_sinks.sign_convention: z and q positive downward, identical to BC2 authority

discrete_reference_audit.q90_reference: independent fixed-column storage identity already used and qualified in BC2-B3
discrete_reference_audit.identity_requirement: qi_from_bulk - qi_from_terminal equals the already-qualified total moving-layer ledger residual up to numerical projection error.
discrete_reference_audit.role_of_theta_i: Reference-only geometry-term diagnostic; theta_i is not yet an authorized reduced-state input.

projection_authority.source: qualified BC2-A2 accepted full Reference profiles
projection_authority.Wt: same segmented conservative terminal-band quadrature repaired and qualified in BC2-B6
projection_authority.theta_i: piecewise-linear pressure-head interpolation at H-d followed by frozen constitutive theta(h)
projection_authority.primary_quadrature: 64-point Gauss-Legendre split at Reference interpolation-node kinks

reported_diagnostics: qi_from_bulk and qi_from_terminal by history and water-table direction

adjudication.qualified_rule: Both supported widths must close the split control-volume identity within all hard gates over every frozen A2 history.

next_if_qualified: BC2-B9 may test response-blind no-fit closures for qi on Reference-projected (Wb,Wt,H) states while retaining the BC2-B7 qH operator.
